hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -o pipefail
# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────── BASE="https://staging-bh.boozang.com" TOKEN="@@BZ_PROJECT_TOKEN@@" PROJECT="6515cd7f81bcda470a5ef8db" ENV=${ENV:-0} SELF=0 GROUP="" SCOPE="" PARAMETER="" SCHEDULE="" TMPDB=true IMAGE="styrman/boozang-runner-dev"
# ── Input summary ───────────────────────────────────────────── echo "=== Boozang Test Run ===" echo "Image: ${IMAGE}" echo "Branch: ${BRANCH}" echo "Test: ${TEST}" echo "Workers: ${WORKERS}" echo "Filter: ${FILTER}" echo "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}" echo "Exemode: ${EXEMODE}" echo "Tmpdb: ${TMPDB}" echo "========================"
# ── Cleanup function ───────────────────────────────────────── cleanup() { echo "Stopping worker containers..." for (( i=1; i<=WORKERS; i++ )); do docker stop "bzworkern${i}" 2>/dev/null && echo " Stopped worker ${i}" || true done docker rm -f $(docker ps -aq --filter "name=bzworkern") 2>/dev/null || true } trap cleanup EXIT
# ── Remove stale containers from previous runs ─────────────── cleanup
# ── Clean up old logs ───────────────────────────────────────── rm -f out_${BUILD_NUMBER}_*.log find . -name "out_*_*.log" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
# ── Build worker URL ────────────────────────────────────────── worker_url() { local key=$1 local suffix=$2 local url="${BASE}/extension" url+="?token=${TOKEN}${PROJECT}" url+="&number=${NUMBER}" url+="&total=${WORKERS}" url+="&filter=${FILTER}" url+="&group=${GROUP}" url+="&scope=${SCOPE}" url+="&parameter=${PARAMETER}" url+="&env=${ENV}" url+="&key=${key}" url+="&self=${SELF}" url+="&exemode=${EXEMODE}" [[ "${TMPDB}" == "false" ]] && url+="&tmpDb=false" url+="#${PROJECT}/${BRANCH}${suffix}" echo "$url" }
# ── Start worker containers ────────────────────────────────── for (( i=2; i<=WORKERS; i++ )); do echo "Starting worker ${i}..." nohup docker run --rm --init \ -v "$(pwd):/var/boozang/" \ --name="bzworkern${i}" \ "${IMAGE}" \ "$(worker_url ${i} '')" \ > "out_${BUILD_NUMBER}_${i}.log" 2>&1 & done
# ── Start master (worker 1) ────────────────────────────────── echo "Starting master (worker 1)..." docker run --rm --init \ -v "$(pwd):/var/boozang/" \ --name="bzworkern1" \ "${IMAGE}" \ "$(worker_url 1 "/${TEST}/run?schedule=${SCHEDULE}")" \ 2>&1 | tee "out_${BUILD_NUMBER}_1.log"
